name: L10 SEVN multi-scale OCR and mask-topology successor
question: Does source-blind multi-scale house-number OCR plus upper-mask credential-to-portal topology materially improve the frozen V1 SEVN address-door pixel result without increasing wrong bindings?

cohort.development_note: The cohort and V1 outcomes are consumed Development. SEVN001 was used for one pre-freeze implementation smoke verifying tile coordinate mapping, mask recovery, containment de-duplication, and an admissible UPPER_RIGHT topology. No other V2 episode output was observed before freeze.

high_resolution_archive.access: Stream the same 24 action-result members directly from the ZIP; write no extracted panorama or rendered image.

action_control.selection_authority: Evaluator truth selects the same frozen scenario-designated action used by V1 before pixel inference.
action_control.runtime_observation: Runtime receives only the public target house number and the action-result pixels. No SEVN door, text, visibility, address-match, or binding label enters OCR, portal proposals, mask de-duplication, or topology.
action_control.claim_boundary: V2 tests a pixel binding representation after a prescribed active observation. It still does not test autonomous action selection.

render_contract.source_projection: Unchanged V1 SEVN equirectangular ring crop

portal_model.license: AGPL-3.0; internal research only pending product-integration license review

ocr.backend: RapidOCR 3.9.2 / PP-OCRv6 small / ONNX Runtime CPUExecutionProvider

ocr.target_match: Unchanged exact alphanumeric equality after deleting punctuation and spaces; no fuzzy aliases.
ocr.passes: One native 1440x1280 full viewport plus six source-blind overlapping tiles.

tile_pass.placement: Evenly span zero to the final valid tile origin on each axis.
tile_pass.resize: Each 864x768 tile is bicubic-resized to 1440x1280, a 1.666667x magnification, then OCR polygons are mapped back to viewport coordinates.

deduplication.ranking: Keep higher OCR confidence, then stable pass and box order, while retaining the set of passes that observed each merged token.

portal_model.author_postprocess: Unchanged V1 mirror suppression and cross-class doorway/door de-duplication.
portal_model.mask_reconstruction: Rasterize each surviving Ultralytics instance polygon at the original 1440x1280 viewport.

deduplication.ranking: Keep higher confidence before class and stable mask bounds.

association.admission: An exact target token must lie within the adaptive expanded upper-mask bounds and its text rectangle must be no farther from actual upper-mask pixels than the Euclidean adaptive radius.
association.ranking: Among admissible text-mask pairs, minimize upper-mask distance divided by adaptive radius, then lateral offset in portal widths, vertical offset in portal heights, and prefer portal and OCR confidence.
association.abstention: No exact target token, no surviving portal mask, or no admissible upper-mask topology returns UNKNOWN.

evaluation.correct: The selected mask centroid lies inside the scaled SEVN target-door box, or both selected-mask precision and target-box coverage meet their frozen minima.
evaluation.wrong: A mask-topology proposal is selected but neither frozen mask truth rule is met.
evaluation.unknown: The runtime abstains before a mask-topology proposal.

gate.interpretation: V2 must add at least three net correct bindings, reduce wrong bindings, retain at least 10 of 11 V1 correct episodes, and recover at least four V1 non-correct episodes.

retention_policy.keep: V2 protocol, evaluator, detailed result, cleanup receipt, updated decision, hashes, V1 baseline, and source archive.
retention_policy.delete: Any reconstructible panorama extraction, viewport, OCR tile, raster mask image, overlay, model scratch output, cache, or task temporary directory after result verification.
retention_policy.implementation: The evaluator performs all image, tile, and mask operations in memory and writes only the result JSON.

stop_rule: Run the frozen 24 episodes once. Do not change tiling, resize, OCR match, mask de-duplication, topology, scoring, gate, model, or action after observing the result. Any successor requires a new protocol version.
